security_scope: Upstream lists fixes for CVE-2026-8461 and CVE-2026-30999 in 8.1.2; the selected pin is n8.1.3. The upstream n8.1.3 Changelog (https://github.com/FFmpeg/FFmpeg/blob/n8.1.3/Changelog) records the 8.1-branch backports for CVE-2026-70628 (dvbsub_parser signed overflow), CVE-2026-70629 (rscc uninitialized data), CVE-2026-70630 (screenpresso short deflate output), CVE-2026-70631 (tiff short inflate output) and CVE-2026-70632 (cfhd transform-2 output width). Debian/NVD CPE ranges say before 9.0 because they track distribution versions rather than these branch backports, and the upstream security web page has no 8.1.3 section. This describes the pinned source, not proof of reachability or equivalence of a shipped artifact. Untrusted media remains untrusted; for a single-user desktop preview flow the documented impact is a bounded residual risk, not an assumption that malformed media is safe. No broader security review is claimed.
